cohort: Women who gave birth at Dhulikhel Hospital between 2007-2009 and 2017-2019 (4215 deliveries in 2007-2009 and 9298 deliveries in 2017-2019)
finding: The rate of vaginal birth after cesarean decreased significantly from 18.33% to 8.8% between the periods of 2007-2009 and 2017-2019.
mod_finding: Vaginal birth after cesarean rate decreased significantly over the study period.
